baseHeader.methodology: Source-linked original summaries and reference-guided educational reconstructions. Models and motion are unvalidated; artist titles do not independently verify taxonomy. Navigation groups are not a universal kingdom system. Microbial behavior depends on strain and conditions. Expansion entries are individually referenced authored morphology studies; legacy Protista/Monera reporting categories do not replace modern domains. Actual screenshots, software checks and draft status are distinct from independent scientific validation.

before.habitat: Forests, wetlands and other vegetated habitats across the Americas
before.range: Fragmented present distribution in the Americas; historic and georeferenced records must not be read as a continuous current native range.
before.nutrition: Carnivore; prey selection varies among regions and habitats
before.summary: A robust American felid with a broad head, muscular forequarters and relatively short tail. Broken rosettes commonly surround smaller dark spots. This record represents the species across its range; the artist’s individual has no documented sex, age or population.

anatomy.name: Broad head and jaw region
anatomy.description: The source surface retains a broad muzzle and strong cheek region. Skull dimensions, jaw loading and bite mechanics have not been measured or simulated.

anatomy.name: Rosetted trunk and forequarters
anatomy.description: The retained atlas has broken rosettes and pale underparts on a muscular trunk. It is an artist coat pattern, not a photographic identification or a calibrated reconstruction of the reference individual.

anatomy.name: Digitigrade forepaw
anatomy.description: The original fingers, wrist and pads articulate with the creator skeleton. Toe spacing, contact pressure, claw sheaths and substrate deformation remain approximate or absent.

behaviors.label: Forepaw placement
behaviors.description: A bounded creator excerpt repositions a forepaw while the animal remains otherwise standing. It stops before the following stretch and is not a complete walking gait.
behaviors.evidence: Species-account and selected captive ethogram context; source artist animation is unmeasured
behaviors.timeScale: uncalibrated creator display seconds; not biological time

rendering.reason: Single source forepaw placement only; no complete multi-stride locomotion or validated contact forces.

behaviors.label: Stretch · single sequence
behaviors.description: A bounded creator stretch lowers the forequarters and extends the forelimbs, then returns toward standing. Timing, vertebral range and paw loading remain unmeasured.
behaviors.evidence: Species-account and selected captive ethogram context; source artist animation is unmeasured
behaviors.timeScale: uncalibrated creator display seconds; not biological time

rendering.reason: Source artist posture; vertebral range, tissue strain and exact paw loading are unmeasured.

behaviors.label: Groom · single sequence
behaviors.description: A bounded creator sequence raises a forepaw toward the face. The species ethogram distinguishes self-cleaning from ingestion of food. It stops instead of looping into another activity.
behaviors.evidence: Species-account and selected captive ethogram context; source artist animation is unmeasured
behaviors.timeScale: uncalibrated creator display seconds; not biological time

rendering.reason: Qualitative paw/face cleaning interpretation. Fur contact, saliva and physiological effects are not modeled.

behaviors.label: Prey handling
behaviors.description: Hunting, food acquisition, carrying, manipulation and ingestion require prey/contact and jaw mechanisms beyond this isolated artist sequence.
behaviors.evidence: Species-account and selected captive ethogram context; source artist animation is unmeasured
behaviors.timeScale: uncalibrated creator display seconds; not biological time

rendering.reason: No complete prey acquisition/handling/ingestion mechanism; grooming is not labelled as feeding.

behaviors.label: Rest / sleep mechanism
behaviors.description: The source standing frame and stretch are not resting or physiological sleep. A supported lying/sitting posture and separate sleep evidence remain incomplete.
behaviors.evidence: Species-account and selected captive ethogram context; source artist animation is unmeasured
behaviors.timeScale: uncalibrated creator display seconds; not biological time

rendering.reason: Supported repose and sleep physiology are not implemented; standing is not relabelled as rest.

behaviors.label: Walk · comparative study
behaviors.description: Two slow four-beat step sequences articulate the retained jaguar skeleton. Each hindpaw advances before the forepaw on the same side; planted paws remain at fixed positions while the trunk advances, with separate swing clearance. Jaguar ethograms establish walking as a behavior; domestic-cat kinematics provide comparative gait context. Joint paths, paw spacing, stride length and nine-second display timing are authored, not measured from a jaguar.
behaviors.evidence: Primary jaguar behavioral observations; comparative domestic-cat gait evidence; authored joint paths
behaviors.timeScale: Nine-second illustrative study; normalized geometry and uncalibrated time

rendering.reason: External walking articulated on the original rig. Jaguar-specific measured kinematics, muscle activity, dynamic balance, forces and energetic costs are not modeled.

sources.title: IUCN/SSC Cat Specialist Group: Jaguar
sources.scope: Selected description and natural-history sections read: robust head/trunk, shorter limbs/tail and distinct rosettes. Not a specimen determination or measured fit.

sources.title: US Fish and Wildlife Service: Jaguar
sources.scope: Selected physical and behavioral account read. An agency species account, not a Smithsonian collection determination.

sources.title: Brunner et al. (2026): Feasts and fasts: feeding regimes and zoo-housed jaguar activity budgets
sources.scope: Full source PDF retrieved; methods context and actual Table 1 on printed p5 viewed. Three captive jaguars over eight weeks; behavioral labels are not measured kinematics or a wild activity schedule. No feeding/physiological result is reproduced by the model.

review.status: Initial source-linked author comparison completed; residual anatomy and movement limitations remain
remainingLimitations: A complete measured or independently reviewed walking/running gait is absent.
Supported resting/lying/sitting and physiological sleep remain incomplete; standing is not relabelled as rest.
Prey acquisition, carrying, manipulation, ingestion and jaw/prey contact require separate mechanisms. Grooming is not feeding.
Model proportions, claw sheaths, pads, fur, tissue strain and optics need expert measurements and further surface work.

review.summary: Retained artist surface with bounded creator excerpts and a finite comparative walking study; measured gait and internal physiology remain unvalidated.
review.movementStudyScope: Finite comparative external walk, with fixed source bone lengths, planted-paw positions and preserved textures. Not independently biologically validated.
